Bryan Chen: Heads up — FinCore legal pinged asking for SOC 2 artifacts + pen-test attestation for the POC. They're also worried about non-prod data residency and whether staging shares any prod resources. They want a quick dedicated pricing ballpark if we need tenant isolation. Can we confirm what we can hand over and a template for the pen-test letter?
Alice Kim: on it. Can you paste their exact artifact list? I can assemble SOC2 summary + ISO snapshot + control owners.
Bryan Chen: here's the ask (copied): "SOC2 Type II summary, evidence of encryption at rest, pen-test attestation letter, data residency statement for staging, list of third-party subprocessors"
Maria Lopez: quick notes from security — we can provide: SOC2 summary PDF (redacted), ISO 27001 certificate copy, and a vendor pen-test attestation signed by our pentest firm. Pen-test report itself is sensitive; we provide attestation letter and can coordinate an NDA for the full report.
Maria Lopez: sample attestation line we usually use: "Redwood Inference attests that an independent third-party penetration test was performed on [date] covering network and application layers. No critical-severity findings remained open at the time of issuance. The full technical report is available to customers under NDA."
Samir Patel: infra notes — staging runs in the same region but is logically isolated (separate k8s namespaces + RBAC + VPC subnets). No customer production data is used in staging by default. If customer requires tenant-level separation we can provision a dedicated tenant (isolated VPC + dedicated capacity).
Samir Patel: quick config snippet for staging ACLs we can share (redacted):
```
namespace: fincore-poc-staging
rbac:
  - role: read-only
    resources: [logs, metrics]
    expires: 7d
network:
  vpc: redwood-staging-eu-2
  subnet: isolated-123
```
Alice Kim: on the evidence handoff — AuditBot can generate a share link to a temporary folder. @Maria Lopez do you want us to strip IPs/hostnames from the SOC2 excerpts?
Maria Lopez: yes please redact IPs, internal hostnames, and any hacker-facing details. Keep control owner names but no internal ticket IDs.
AuditBot: Uploaded artifacts to internal share: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/fincore-poc (expires in 14 days). Folder contains: SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted), ISO27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-attestation-template.docx, subprocessors.csv :white_check_mark:
Bryan Chen: perfect. For pricing — what's the rough dedicated tenant cost for POC? Customer asking to include in proposal.
Samir Patel: ballpark for dedicated tenant (monthly): est. $15k/mo reserved + one-time onboarding ~ $8k (networking + isolation config). If they need SLA bump add ~ $3k/mo. These are rough — can put as preliminary numbers.
Bryan Chen: thanks. I'll communicate: provide attestation + redacted SOC2 excerpts now, offer dedicated tenant as an option with the pricing. Also ask if they want NDA to get the full pen-test report.
Alice Kim: I'll package the docset and upload a customer-facing zip (no internal logs). Planning to send by EOD.
Maria Lopez: ping me when you send NDA request; we'll route the full report under NDA and track access.
Bryan Chen: copying the action items: 1) Alice — assemble redacted SOC2/ISO + pen-test attestation template and upload to share (EOD). 2) Samir — confirm dedicated tenant onboarding timeline (ETA 5 business days) and final price. 3) Maria — sign-off on redactions and be ready to initiate NDA for full report.
Alice Kim: noted. I'll post the customer-facing link here once done. :thumbsup:
Bryan Chen: thanks all.
